summary: UTime Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a 10-for-1 share consolidation effective June 22, 2026, to regain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance, cancellation of 3,672 Class A shares from 2025 private placements due to payment issues, and issuance of 180,000 restricted shares to each of five directors under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, spinoff, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is routine corporate housekeeping and equity plan administration with a reverse stock split to satisfy listing standards.
